content:
Incident Bot: Pager: LATENCY_P1 - fastgen-1 (eu-west) — elevated tail latency observed since 10:22 UTC. Pager routed to @Maya and SRE on-call.
Maya: I'm oncall, joining a quick triage call. Initial dashboards show 95th > 2.5s for generation tokens, increased genqueue depth on eu genpool. No 5xx spikes reported.
Jordan: Investigating logs — increased GC/heap churn on node-eu-3 and high kernel scheduling delays after last runtime rollout (fastgen-runtime v2.1). Possible regress causing token emission stalls.
Emma: Can we confirm customer impact before I draft status page? Need rough scope (% of requests affected) and whether it's only EU region.
Maya: Scope: approx ~12-18% of hosted gen requests from eu-west saw degraded latency during the window; streaming chunking had most visible impact. No data plane errors; just slowed responses. Recommend "Degraded performance" for EU generation endpoints.
Emma: Drafting initial status page copy now — posting below for quick review: 
```
Initial note (Investigating)
- Summary: We are investigating reports of increased generation latency for EU-hosted models (fastgen-1). Some streaming and large-sequence responses may be slower than normal.
- Impact: Partial degradation of generation performance for EU-hosted requests. Some requests may experience increased response times; no elevated error rates observed.
- ETA: Engineers are actively investigating and rolling mitigations. We will post updates every ~10 minutes or when there is a significant change.
```
Jordan: I'm starting a rollback of the runtime change for eu nodes to v2.0 (candidate suspected). Rolling back in a canary then wider if metrics look good.
Deploy Bot: rollback job queued: job-1829, canary batch on node-eu-3 started (1/6).
Jordan: Canary rollback completed, canary metrics look good. Proceeding with full rollback across eu genpool (3/6 in progress).
Maya: Monitoring dashboards — genqueue for the pool is dropping, tail latency trending down. If rollback completes cleanly, propose moving status to "Monitoring" then "Resolved" after 5m clean window.
Ryan: Quick legal/comms check: avoid phrasing implying data loss; "degraded performance" + "no error rate increase" is fine. Approve publish.
Emma: Publishing initial status page update now (Investigating -> Degraded performance). Also posting internal incident note to #eng-oncall and #product.
Deploy Bot: rollback job job-1829 progress: 100% complete.
Jordan: Rollback finished across eu pool — 95th latency back to ~420ms, genqueue normalized.
Maya: Observability: 10-minute clean window in progress. No reoccurrence seen.
Emma: Update: moving status to Monitoring — rollback appears successful, performance improving. Will publish resolved notice after clean window.
Emma: Resolved: Performance restored to normal across EU generation endpoints. Status page updated to Resolved. Closing customer-facing incident. Thanks everyone — follow-up postmortem to be scheduled for RCA and preventing future regressions. :white_check_mark:
